definition.ensemble: statistic of the early Gaussian field: centres uniform in Lagrangian (early photon-normalised) coordinates; mass and volume weighting differ only beyond first order; connected variance of the tangent field
definition.field: dust rest-mass density (CDM + baryons after decoupling), dust rest frame
definition.flrw_limit: standard linear top-hat variance ([JLH13] Eq. (2)); D_W -> 1 - (5/6) f_v0
definition.foliation_time: dust-orthogonal foliation of [GM] Sec. 3; dust proper time t (common time); present epoch f_v(t0) = f_v0
definition.linear: formal tangent statistic (owner decision D1): zero-amplitude tangent of the global-contrast map of a Lagrangian top hat around the smooth two-phase tracker state, applied to the early Gaussian field (linear extrapolation, as LCDM's linear sigma at 8 Mpc/h)
definition.mean: global Buchert volume average <rho>_D = M_D/V_D on the same slice
definition.not_the_ensemble_response: the ensemble-mean response of the true contrast (cross-propagator <delta_L delta_0*>'/P_0) averages the derivative of (H3) over finite small-scale fluctuations and differs from the tangent (two-state example: 0.27468 against f_w = 0.263); not computed (GH-F1)

radius_conventions.b_diagnostic: L/h_dressed wall-comoving (needs the underived dressed map)

definition.region: Lagrangian top hat: dust elements with early photon-normalised comoving labels within radius R
definition.smoothing_rule: G_R(k) = G(k) W(kR), G the unsmoothed carrier of a Lagrangian point; exact for the tangent, stated as part of the definition
definition.statistic: (H10) sigma^2 = int dln k Delta^2_u G^2 W^2(kR); real-space (H11)
